mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tui_dynamic (id, user_id, content, images, like_count, comment_count, share_count, create_time, update_time, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{images}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{shareCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, content, images, like_count, comment_count, share_count, create_time, update_time, status FROM tui_dynamic WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0

choose.when:
SELECT id, user_id, content, images, like_count, comment_count, share_count, create_time, update_time, status FROM tui_dynamic WHERE status = 0 AND id IN
#{id}
choose.otherwise: SELECT id, user_id, content, images, like_count, comment_count, share_count, create_time, update_time, status FROM tui_dynamic WHERE 1 = 0

mapper.update: UPDATE tui_dynamic SET like_count = like_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE tui_dynamic SET comment_count = comment_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE tui_dynamic SET share_count = share_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE tui_dynamic SET status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tui_dynamic SET status = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tui_dynamic WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY like_count DESC, comment_count DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
